# Lossy Enqueue Element

![Lossy Enqueue Element function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/synchronization/queue/06_Lossy%20enqueue%20element.svg)

[Synchronization functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Atomically evicts the oldest element only if a bounded FIFO is full, then appends the new element without waiting. The overflow element is meaningful only when overflow? is true. Ordinary Enqueue does not use this lossy behavior. Queue&lt;T&gt; is an execution resource reference; element is the ordinary T value. Public FROG target compilation remains unavailable.

## Queue behavior

Never waits. If a bounded queue is full, it atomically evicts the oldest message and appends the new one. overflow element is meaningful only when overflow? is true. Ordinary Enqueue does not perform this loss.

Queue&lt;T&gt; is a nominal execution-resource access reference. The complete T schema is invariant; an Array, Cluster or Enum message remains one T value. Collection outputs add one outer rank-1 Array.
